preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The number of cities N is between 1 and 5000, inclusive.
The names of the cities A and B are strings with lengths between 1 and 50 characters, inclusive.
The price C is an integer between 1 and 1000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(Ai != Bi for Ai, Bi, Ci in input_cards)
preconditions.description: No two cities have the same name.

postconditions.expression: all(output_cards[i] == expected_order[i] for i in range(N-1))
postconditions.description: The first N-1 lines of the output contain the cards in the order they should have been.

postconditions.expression: output_total_cost == sum(Ci for Ai, Bi, Ci in expected_order)
postconditions.description: The N-th line of the output contains the total cost of the journey.
